what: Fit STR on a small example
title: Getting started: two packages, one toolkit
text: coefficient vector starts intercept. hr() returns path object; standard coef() predict() methods select path location. following -sample predictions illustrate API, prediction accuracy.
code: library(softridge) set.seed(25) X <- matrix(rnorm(60 * 100), 60, 100) beta <- c(2, -1.5, 1, rep(0, 97)) y <- drop(X %*% beta + rnorm(60)) foldid <- rep(1:3, length.out = nrow(X)) grid <- hr_grid(X, y, nk = 3, ng = 5) fit <- cv_hr(X, y, grid = grid, foldid = foldid) c(k = fit$k, threshold = fit$gamma, selected = length(fit$selected)) ##            k    threshold     selected  ##   0.02851467   0.00000000 100.00000000 head(fit$coef) ## [1]  0.01636806  0.89734169 -0.82684181  0.41227578  0.19559541 -0.11110748 path <- hr(X, y, k = fit$k, gamma = fit$gamma) head(predict(path, X)) ## [1]  2.5790156 -0.5012138 -3.2782377  2.5351456 -1.8415457  0.8417265
